about_the_game:
This additional content does not add new gameplay but includes exclusive materials that give you a behind-the-scenes look at the development of "I'm 16 and Pregnant".

This DLC includes:

  • All in-game backgrounds in original quality

  • Unused backgrounds and concept art

  • Music tracks from the game

  • Character sketches and early concepts

  • Screenshots of script fragments

By purchasing this DLC, you not only gain access to extra content but also support the project's development. All proceeds will go toward improving the original game and creating its sequel.

Thank you for your support!
